verdict.title: Result
verdict.STOP.title: Stop. Do not pay or travel yet.
verdict.STOP.body: One or more serious points in this offer go against MEA advice. Do not pay any fee until you have checked each point with the Protector of Emigrants.
verdict.VERIFY_FIRST.title: Check these points before you pay.
verdict.VERIFY_FIRST.body: Some points are missing or unclear. Get written answers before you pay any agent or travel.
verdict.NO_RED_FLAGS_FOUND.title: Nothing flagged in this check
verdict.NO_RED_FLAGS_FOUND.body: No red flags found. Confirm with the Protector of Emigrants before paying anything.
verdict.ra_list_date: Agent list checked: MEA active recruiting agent list dated {date}.
rule.R1_TOURIST_VISA.title: Tourist visa is not for jobs
rule.R1_TOURIST_VISA.hit: The offer uses a tourist or visit visa. MEA advice says a tourist visa cannot be used for work.
rule.R1_TOURIST_VISA.clear: The offer says the visa is for work.
rule.R1_TOURIST_VISA.unknown: The offer does not say what visa you will get. Ask the employer for the visa type in writing.
rule.R2_RA_NOT_LISTED.title: Agent not on MEA list
rule.R2_RA_NOT_LISTED.hit: This agent was not found on MEA's active recruiting agent list dated {date}. Ask for the agent's RC number and check it on eMigrate before you pay.
rule.R2_RA_NOT_LISTED.clear: This agent appears on MEA's active recruiting agent list dated {date}. Still confirm on eMigrate.
rule.R2_RA_NOT_LISTED.unknown: Saavdhan could not check this agent against MEA's list.
rule.R3_NO_RC_NUMBER.title: Agent RC number missing
rule.R3_NO_RC_NUMBER.hit: The offer does not show a recruiting agent RC number. Ask the agent for the RC number in writing before you pay.
rule.R3_NO_RC_NUMBER.clear: The offer shows an agent RC number. Check it on eMigrate before you pay.
rule.R3_NO_RC_NUMBER.unknown: The offer does not say if there is an agent. Ask who will recruit you and for their RC number.
rule.R4_FEE_OVER_CAP.title: Fee is above MEA limit
rule.R4_FEE_OVER_CAP.hit: The fee is above Rs {cap} (Rs 30,000 + 18% GST, as reported from MEA advice). Ask the agent to explain the fee in writing before you pay.
rule.R4_FEE_OVER_CAP.clear: The fee is within Rs {cap} (Rs 30,000 + 18% GST, as reported from MEA advice).
rule.R4_FEE_OVER_CAP.unknown: The offer does not say how much you must pay. Ask for the full fee in writing.
rule.R5_NO_TRIPARTITE_CONTRACT.title: No three-party contract mentioned
rule.R5_NO_TRIPARTITE_CONTRACT.hit: The offer does not show a contract signed by the employer, the agent and you. Ask for a copy of the three-party contract before you pay.
rule.R5_NO_TRIPARTITE_CONTRACT.clear: The offer says the employer, the agent and you all sign one contract.
rule.R5_NO_TRIPARTITE_CONTRACT.unknown: The offer does not say who the contract is with. Ask who will sign it.
rule.R6_HIGH_RISK_CORRIDOR.title: Route seen in fake-job cases
rule.R6_HIGH_RISK_CORRIDOR.hit: This job and route match a pattern seen in reported fake-job cases (Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos; data-entry/IT/support roles). MEA has warned about such offers.
rule.R6_HIGH_RISK_CORRIDOR.clear: The route and job do not match the corridor pattern Saavdhan checks.
rule.R6_HIGH_RISK_CORRIDOR.unknown: The offer does not give the job role or the route. Add the role and every country you will pass through.
rule.R7_INFORMAL_CHANNEL_ONLY.title: Offer only through chat apps
rule.R7_INFORMAL_CHANNEL_ONLY.hit: The offer lists only chat apps or a phone number. Ask for an office address, an email and a website you can check.
rule.R7_INFORMAL_CHANNEL_ONLY.clear: The offer lists an office address, an email or a website, not just chat.
rule.R7_INFORMAL_CHANNEL_ONLY.unknown: The offer does not say how to reach the agent. Ask for an office address and an email.
rule.R8_NO_RECEIPT.title: No receipt promised
rule.R8_NO_RECEIPT.hit: A fee is asked, but no receipt is promised. Ask for a written receipt for every payment before you pay.
rule.R8_NO_RECEIPT.clear: The offer promises a receipt for any fee paid.
rule.R8_NO_RECEIPT.unknown: The offer does not say if a receipt will be given. Ask before you pay.
rule.R9_PBBY_MISSING.title: PBBY insurance not mentioned
rule.R9_PBBY_MISSING.hit: PBBY insurance (Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana) is not mentioned. Ask whether it applies to your job.
rule.R9_PBBY_MISSING.unknown: The offer does not say whether PBBY insurance applies.
rule.H1_SALARY_ANOMALY.title: Salary looks unusually high
rule.H1_SALARY_ANOMALY.hit: This is a warning sign, not a legal rule. The salary looks much higher than usual for this job, so ask the employer to explain it.
rule.H1_SALARY_ANOMALY.clear: The salary is in the usual range for this job.
rule.H1_SALARY_ANOMALY.unknown: The offer does not give a salary. Ask for the monthly salary in writing.
rule.H2_PASSPORT_HANDOVER.title: Agent asks to hold your passport
rule.H2_PASSPORT_HANDOVER.hit: This is a warning sign, not a legal rule. Do not give your passport to an agent until you have a signed contract and have checked the agent.
rule.H2_PASSPORT_HANDOVER.clear: The offer does not ask for your passport.
rule.H2_PASSPORT_HANDOVER.unknown: The offer does not say whether your passport will be kept.
rule.H3_PRESSURE.title: Pressure to decide quickly
rule.H3_PRESSURE.hit: Warning sign, not a legal rule: the offer pushes you to decide fast. Take time to check before you pay.
rule.H3_PRESSURE.clear: The offer does not push you to decide quickly.
rule.H3_PRESSURE.unknown: The offer does not say how long you have to decide.
next.STOP: Do not pay or travel yet. Check each point with the Protector of Emigrants first.
next.VERIFY_FIRST: Get written answers to each point. Then check the agent on eMigrate before you pay.
next.NO_RED_FLAGS_FOUND: Confirm with the Protector of Emigrants before paying anything.
family.alert_body: Simulated alert: {alias} missed a check-in. Open the report packet to see the offer details and what to do next.
limits.verify_contacts: Verify helpline contacts on official sites before use.
